_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for business facts. Templates, JSON-LD, the sitemap and llms.txt all read from here, so NAP consistency is structural rather than manually maintained. Anything with a `null` is an open question for Wesleigh (see the plan checklist). Do not invent values: a null renders nothing, a wrong value publishes a false claim and contradicts the Google Business Profile.
name: Collaborative Construction, LLC
description: Residential construction, additions, renovation and independent project oversight.
footerBlurb: Residential construction, renovation and independent project oversight. A professional, client-centered approach from planning through completion.
_addressComment: Must match the Google Business Profile character for character. Google cross-references the two and inconsistent NAP is a known local-ranking drag. This is Wesleigh's home address and he confirmed publishing it; it is already public on the GBP. If that ever changes, switch the GBP to a service-area business FIRST, then shorten `display` and null out `street` here.

address.display: 16 Terry Lou Ave, East Falmouth, MA 02536

_serviceAreaComment: Wesleigh has not yet resolved the service-area question. 4 of 7 portfolio projects (Belmont, Newton, Carlisle, Dudley) sit outside the areas claimed below. See docs and the plan checklist. Changing this array changes the areaServed schema, the footer, and the location pages together.
_areaServedDisplay: Prose form for llms.txt and page copy. areaServed below is the discrete list schema.org needs as AdministrativeArea nodes; keep the two in agreement.
areaServedDisplay: Cape Cod and the Islands, and the South Shore of Massachusetts.
_hoursComment: Copied from the live Google Business Profile exactly as it reads today, so the site and Google cannot disagree. Sunday closed is confirmed. The owner believes Saturday is 7-4 rather than the 7-12 shown here; if so, correct it in the GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE FIRST, then update this file to match. Never change this file alone: an inconsistency between the site and the GBP is a known local-ranking drag, and the GBP is the copy Google trusts.
_licenseComment: Owner to supply from ContractorHub.mass.gov. Never guess. When set, base.njk shows them in the footer and lib/schema.js uses the CSL. Massachusetts says residential contractor advertising, including websites, must show the active HIC registration number. A third party listing (BuildZoom, Mar 27 2026) says an HIC registration is active, but it gives no number.
_socialComment: Updated October 21, 2026 after the browser agent checked both accounts. facebook is the company page https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61595651094549 and linkedin is https://www.linkedin.com/in/collaborative-construction-56761b444/ (a copied LinkedIn link can end in ?isSelfProfile=true; leave it off). The Facebook page with id 61593017512930 is a SEPARATE older page named Collaborative Construction LLC | Falmouth MA that uses a personal name in its email; do not link it. googleBusinessProfile is unchanged.
_canonicalUrlComment: Use canonical profile URLs, never share/redirect links. The old facebook value was https://www.facebook.com/share/14koskagbeC/?mibextid=wwXIfr - a share link carrying the mibextid click-tracking parameter, which redirects to the value below. A redirecting, parameterised URL is a weak sameAs signal. Verified 2026-10-13 by following the redirect.
_googleComment: Identifiers for the Google Business Profile, verified 2026-10-13 by resolving the owner-supplied review link. cid is the numeric customer ID used by the canonical Maps URL above; placeId is the Places API identifier. reviewUrl is the owner-supplied link that opens the write-a-review form directly.
